main.description: A declaration of an account's preferences for appearing in content discovery surfaces.

hideFromAlgorithmicRecommendations.description: Whether the account requests that its posts be hidden from algorithmic recommendations. Consumers must treat a missing record as false.

bskyAppProgressGuide.description: If set, an active progress guide. Once completed, can be set to undefined. Should have unspecced fields tracking progress.

bskyAppStatePref.description: A grab bag of state that's specific to the bsky.app program. Third-party apps shouldn't use this.

isBetaUser.description: Indicates if the user is participating in the beta features program.

nuxs.description: Storage for NUXs the user has encountered.

queuedNudges.description: An array of tokens which identify nudges (modals, popups, tours, highlight dots) that should be shown to the user.

labelerDid.description: Which labeler does this preference apply to? If undefined, applies globally.

declaredAgePref.description: Read-only preference containing value(s) inferred from the user's declared birthdate. Absence of this preference object in the response indicates that the user has not made a declaration.

isOverAge13.description: Indicates if the user has declared that they are over 13 years of age.

isOverAge16.description: Indicates if the user has declared that they are over 16 years of age.

isOverAge18.description: Indicates if the user has declared that they are over 18 years of age.

feed.description: The URI of the feed, or an identifier which describes the feed.

hideQuotePosts.description: Hide quote posts in the feed.

hideRepliesByLikeCount.description: Hide replies in the feed if they do not have this number of likes.

hideRepliesByUnfollowed.description: Hide replies in the feed if they are not by followed users.

items.description: A list of URIs of posts the account owner has hidden.

tags.description: A list of tags which describe the account owner's interests gathered during onboarding.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the account owner last updated their interests.

knownFollowers.description: The subject's followers whom you also follow

hiddenFeedIds.description: A list of feed IDs that the user has hidden from live events.

hideAllFeeds.description: Whether to hide all feeds from live events.

mutedWord.description: A word that the account owner has muted.

actorTarget.description: Groups of users to apply the muted word to. If undefined, applies to all users.

expiresAt.description: The date and time at which the muted word will expire and no longer be applied.

targets.description: The intended targets of the muted word.

items.description: A list of words the account owner has muted.

nux.description: A new user experiences (NUX) storage object

data.description: Arbitrary data for the NUX. The structure is defined by the NUX itself. Limited to 300 characters.

expiresAt.description: The date and time at which the NUX will expire and should be considered completed.

birthDate.description: The birth date of account owner.

postInteractionSettingsPref.description: Default post interaction settings for the account. These values should be applied as default values when creating new posts. These refs should mirror the threadgate and postgate records exactly.

postgateEmbeddingRules.description: Matches postgate record. List of rules defining who can embed this users posts. If value is an empty array or is undefined, no particular rules apply and anyone can embed.

threadgateAllowRules.description: Matches threadgate record. List of rules defining who can reply to this users posts. If value is an empty array, no one can reply. If value is undefined, anyone can reply.

embed.description: An optional embed associated with the status.

expiresAt.description: The date when this status will expire. The application might choose to no longer return the status after expiration.

isActive.description: True if the status is not expired, false if it is expired. Only present if expiration was set.

isDisabled.description: True if the user's go-live access has been disabled by a moderator, false otherwise.

verificationPrefs.description: Preferences for how verified accounts appear in the app.

hideBadges.description: Hide the blue check badges for verified accounts and trusted verifiers.

verificationState.description: Represents the verification information about the user this object is attached to.

trustedVerifierStatus.description: The user's status as a trusted verifier.

verifications.description: All verifications issued by trusted verifiers on behalf of this user. Verifications by untrusted verifiers are not included.

verifiedStatus.description: The user's status as a verified account.

verificationView.description: An individual verification for an associated subject.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the verification was created.

isValid.description: True if the verification passes validation, otherwise false.

issuer.description: The user who issued this verification.

issuerDisplayName.description: The display name of the issuer.

uri.description: The AT-URI of the verification record.

viewerState.description: Metadata about the requesting account's relationship with the subject account. Only has meaningful content for authed requests.

activitySubscription.description: This property is present only in selected cases, as an optimization.

knownFollowers.description: This property is present only in selected cases, as an optimization.

muted.description: Whether the account is fully muted, directly or via a mutelist. False when the mute is scoped to specific kinds; see mutedOnlyReposts and mutedOnlyQuoteposts.

mutedOnlyQuoteposts.description: Whether the account's quote posts are muted. Scoped mutes are exclusive with muted: this can be true while muted is false. If muted is true, this will be false.

mutedOnlyReposts.description: Whether the account's reposts are muted. Scoped mutes are exclusive with muted: this can be true while muted is false. If muted is true, this will be false.

main.description: A declaration of a Bluesky account profile.

avatar.description: Small image to be displayed next to posts from account. AKA, 'profile picture'

banner.description: Larger horizontal image to display behind profile view.

labels.description: Self-label values, specific to the Bluesky application, on the overall account.

live.description: Advertises an account as currently offering live content.

main.description: A declaration of a Bluesky account status.

durationMinutes.description: The duration of the status in minutes. Applications can choose to impose minimum and maximum limits.

embed.description: An optional embed associated with the status.

aspectRatio.description: width:height represents an aspect ratio. It may be approximate, and may not correspond to absolute dimensions in any given unit.

colorRGB.description: RGB color definition, inspired by site.standard.theme.color#rgb

associatedRefs.description: StrongRefs (uri+cid) of the Atmosphere records that backed this view.

main.description: A representation of some externally linked content (eg, a URL and 'card'), embedded in a Bluesky record (eg, a post).

associatedProfiles.description: Profiles of the owners of the Atmosphere records that backed this view.

associatedRefs.description: StrongRefs (uri+cid) of the Atmosphere records that backed this view.

createdAt.description: When the external content was created, if available. Example: a publication date, for an article.

readingTime.description: Estimated reading time in minutes, if applicable and available.

updatedAt.description: When the external content was updated, if available.

viewExternalSource.description: The source of an external embed, such as a standard.site publication.

icon.description: Fully-qualified URL where an icon representing the source can be fetched. For example, CDN location provided by the App View.

uri.description: URI of the source, if available. Example: the https:// URL of a site.standard.publication record.

viewExternalSourceTheme.description: The theme colors of an external source, such as a site.standard.publication. These colors may be used when rendering an embed from that source.

alt.description: Alt text description of the image, for accessibility.

items.description: The schema-level maxLength of 20 is a future-proof ceiling. Clients should currently enforce a soft limit of 10 items in authoring UIs.
The media items in the gallery. Each item may be of a different type, but all types must be supported by the client.

alt.description: Alt text description of the image, for accessibility.

fullsize.description: Fully-qualified URL where a large version of the image can be fetched. May or may not be the exact original blob. For example, CDN location provided by the App View.

thumbnail.description: Fully-qualified URL where a thumbnail of the image can be fetched. For example, CDN location provided by the App View.

app.bsky.embed.gallery.description: An assortment of media embedded in a Bluesky record (eg, a post).

alt.description: Alt text description of the image, for accessibility.

image.description: The raw image file. May be up to 2 MB, formerly limited to 1 MB.

alt.description: Alt text description of the image, for accessibility.

fullsize.description: Fully-qualified URL where a large version of the image can be fetched. May or may not be the exact original blob. For example, CDN location provided by the App View.

thumb.description: Fully-qualified URL where a thumbnail of the image can be fetched. For example, CDN location provided by the App View.

app.bsky.embed.images.description: A set of images embedded in a Bluesky record (eg, a post).

app.bsky.embed.record.description: A representation of a record embedded in a Bluesky record (eg, a post). For example, a quote-post, or sharing a feed generator record.

app.bsky.embed.recordWithMedia.description: A representation of a record embedded in a Bluesky record (eg, a post), alongside other compatible embeds. For example, a quote post and image, or a quote post and external URL card.

alt.description: Alt text description of the video, for accessibility.

presentation.description: A hint to the client about how to present the video.

video.description: The mp4 video file. May be up to 300mb, formerly limited to 100mb.

presentation.description: A hint to the client about how to present the video.

app.bsky.embed.video.description: A video embedded in a Bluesky record (eg, a post).

clickthroughAuthor.description: User clicked through to the author of the feed item

clickthroughEmbed.description: User clicked through to the embedded content of the feed item

clickthroughItem.description: User clicked through to the feed item

clickthroughReposter.description: User clicked through to the reposter of the feed item

contentModeUnspecified.description: Declares the feed generator returns any types of posts.

contentModeVideo.description: Declares the feed generator returns posts containing app.bsky.embed.video embeds.

feedContext.description: Context provided by feed generator that may be passed back alongside interactions.

opThreadPostCount.description: The total number of posts in the contiguous OP thread that this post belongs to. Only present when this post is part of the OP thread.

opThreadPostIndex.description: The 1-indexed position of this post within the contiguous OP thread. Only present when this post is part of the OP thread.

reqId.description: Unique identifier per request that may be passed back alongside interactions.

feedContext.description: Context on a feed item that was originally supplied by the feed generator on getFeedSkeleton.

reqId.description: Unique identifier per request that may be passed back alongside interactions.

interactionReply.description: User replied to the feed item

interactionSeen.description: Feed item was seen by user

knownLikers.description: The post's likers whom you also follow

grandparentAuthor.description: When parent is a reply to another post, this is the author of that post.

requestLess.description: Request that less content like the given feed item be shown in the feed

requestMore.description: Request that more content like the given feed item be shown in the feed

feedContext.description: Context that will be passed through to client and may be passed to feed generator back alongside interactions.

threadContext.description: Metadata about this post within the context of the thread it is in.

viewerState.description: Metadata about the requesting account's relationship with the subject content. Only has meaningful content for authed requests.

knownLikers.description: This property is present only in selected cases, as an optimization.

main.description: Record declaring of the existence of a feed generator, and containing metadata about it. The record can exist in any repository.

acceptsInteractions.description: Declaration that a feed accepts feedback interactions from a client through app.bsky.feed.sendInteractions

main.description: Record declaring a 'like' of a piece of subject content.
Record containing a Bluesky post.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.

facets.description: Annotations of text (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc)

labels.description: Self-label values for this post. Effectively content warnings.

langs.description: Indicates human language of post primary text content.

tags.description: Additional hashtags, in addition to any included in post text and facets.

text.description: The primary post content. May be an empty string, if there are embeds.

textSlice.description: Deprecated. Use app.bsky.richtext instead -- A text segment. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive. Indices are for utf16-encoded strings.

main.description: Record defining interaction rules for a post. The record key (rkey) of the postgate record must match the record key of the post, and that record must be in the same repository.

detachedEmbeddingUris.description: List of AT-URIs embedding this post that the author has detached from.

embeddingRules.description: List of rules defining who can embed this post. If value is an empty array or is undefined, no particular rules apply and anyone can embed.

main.description: Record representing a 'repost' of an existing Bluesky post.

followerRule.description: Allow replies from actors who follow you.

followingRule.description: Allow replies from actors you follow.

listRule.description: Allow replies from actors on a list.

main.description: Record defining interaction gating rules for a thread (aka, reply controls). The record key (rkey) of the threadgate record must match the record key of the thread's root post, and that record must be in the same repository.

allow.description: List of rules defining who can reply to this post. If value is an empty array, no one can reply. If value is undefined, anyone can reply.

mentionRule.description: Allow replies from actors mentioned in your post.

main.description: Record declaring a 'block' relationship against another account. NOTE: blocks are public in Bluesky; see blog posts for details.

subject.description: DID of the account to be blocked.

curatelist.description: A list of actors used for curation purposes such as list feeds or interaction gating.

subjectOptedOut.description: Set to true when the subject has opted out of appearing in the reference list. Only set when the viewer owns the list.

referenceListOptOut.description: The authenticated viewer's app.bsky.graph.referencelistoptout record URI for this reference list. Only set for reference lists. A client can delete this record to undo the opt-out.

modlist.description: A list of actors to apply an aggregate moderation action (mute/block) on.

notFoundActor.description: indicates that a handle or DID could not be resolved

referencelist.description: A list of actors used for only for reference purposes such as within a starter pack.

relationship.description: lists the bi-directional graph relationships between one actor (not indicated in the object), and the target actors (the DID included in the object)

blockedBy.description: if the actor is blocked by this DID, contains the AT-URI of the block record

blockedByList.description: if the actor is blocked by this DID via a block list, contains the AT-URI of the listblock record

blocking.description: if the actor blocks this DID, this is the AT-URI of the block record

blockingByList.description: if the actor blocks this DID via a block list, this is the AT-URI of the listblock record

followedBy.description: if the actor is followed by this DID, contains the AT-URI of the follow record

following.description: if the actor follows this DID, this is the AT-URI of the follow record

main.description: Record declaring a social 'follow' relationship of another account. Duplicate follows will be ignored by the AppView.
Record representing a list of accounts (actors). Scope includes both moderation-oriented lists and curration-oriented lists.

name.description: Display name for list; can not be empty.

purpose.description: Defines the purpose of the list (aka, moderation-oriented or curration-oriented)

main.description: Record representing a block relationship against an entire an entire list of accounts (actors).

subject.description: Reference (AT-URI) to the mod list record.

main.description: Record representing an account's inclusion on a specific list. The AppView will ignore duplicate listitem records.

subject.description: The account which is included on the list.

subject.description: Canonical, DID-based AT URI of the app.bsky.graph.list record from which the author requests omission.

name.description: Display name for starter pack; can not be empty.

createdAt.description: Date of when the verification was created.

displayName.description: Display name of the subject the verification applies to at the moment of verifying, which might not be the same at the time of viewing. The verification is only valid if the current displayName matches the one at the time of verifying.

handle.description: Handle of the subject the verification applies to at the moment of verifying, which might not be the same at the time of viewing. The verification is only valid if the current handle matches the one at the time of verifying.

subject.description: DID of the subject the verification applies to.

labelValueDefinitions.description: Label values created by this labeler and scoped exclusively to it. Labels defined here will override global label definitions for this labeler.

labelValues.description: The label values which this labeler publishes. May include global or custom labels.

reasonTypes.description: The set of report reason 'codes' which are in-scope for this service to review and action. These usually align to policy categories. If not defined (distinct from empty array), all reason types are allowed.

subjectCollections.description: Set of record types (collection NSIDs) which can be reported to this service. If not defined (distinct from empty array), default is any record type.

subjectTypes.description: The set of subject types (account, record, etc) this service accepts reports on.

subjectActivitySubscription.description: Object used to store activity subscription data in stash.

byteSlice.description: Specifies the sub-string range a facet feature applies to. Start index is inclusive, end index is exclusive. Indices are zero-indexed, counting bytes of the UTF-8 encoded text. NOTE: some languages, like Javascript, use UTF-16 or Unicode codepoints for string slice indexing; in these languages, convert to byte arrays before working with facets.

link.description: Facet feature for a URL. The text URL may have been simplified or truncated, but the facet reference should be a complete URL.

main.description: Annotation of a sub-string within rich text.

mention.description: Facet feature for mention of another account. The text is usually a handle, including a '@' prefix, but the facet reference is a DID.

tag.description: Facet feature for a hashtag. The text usually includes a '#' prefix, but the facet reference should not (except in the case of 'double hash tags').

allowGroupInvites.description: Declaration about group chat invitation preferences for the record owner.

label.description: Metadata tag on an atproto resource (eg, repo or record).

cid.description: Optionally, CID specifying the specific version of 'uri' resource this label applies to.

cts.description: Timestamp when this label was created.

exp.description: Timestamp at which this label expires (no longer applies).

neg.description: If true, this is a negation label, overwriting a previous label.

src.description: DID of the actor who created this label.

uri.description: AT URI of the record, repository (account), or other resource that this label applies to.

val.description: The short string name of the value or type of this label.

ver.description: The AT Protocol version of the label object.

labelValueDefinition.description: Declares a label value and its expected interpretations and behaviors.

adultOnly.description: Does the user need to have adult content enabled in order to configure this label?

blurs.description: What should this label hide in the UI, if applied? 'content' hides all of the target; 'media' hides the images/video/audio; 'none' hides nothing.

defaultSetting.description: The default setting for this label.

identifier.description: The value of the label being defined. Must only include lowercase ascii and the '-' character ([a-z-]+).

severity.description: How should a client visually convey this label? 'inform' means neutral and informational; 'alert' means negative and warning; 'none' means show nothing.

labelValueDefinitionStrings.description: Strings which describe the label in the UI, localized into a specific language.

description.description: A longer description of what the label means and why it might be applied.

lang.description: The code of the language these strings are written in.

name.description: A short human-readable name for the label.

selfLabel.description: Metadata tag on an atproto record, published by the author within the record. Note that schemas should use #selfLabels, not #selfLabel.

val.description: The short string name of the value or type of this label.

selfLabels.description: Metadata tags on an atproto record, published by the author within the record.

main.description: Find labels relevant to the provided AT-URI patterns. Public endpoint for moderation services, though may return different or additional results with auth.

sources.description: Optional list of label sources (DIDs) to filter on.

uriPatterns.description: List of AT URI patterns to match (boolean 'OR'). Each may be a prefix (ending with '*'; will match inclusive of the string leading to '*'), or a full URI.

errors.description: No lexicon was resolved for the NSID.
errors.name: LexiconNotFound

cid.description: The CID of the lexicon schema record.

uri.description: The AT-URI of the lexicon schema record.

main.description: Representation of Lexicon schemas themselves, when published as atproto records. Note that the schema language is not defined in Lexicon; this meta schema currently only includes a single version field ('lexicon'). See the atproto specifications for description of the other expected top-level fields ('id', 'defs', etc).

lexicon.description: Indicates the 'version' of the Lexicon language. Must be '1' for the current atproto/Lexicon schema system.

main.description: Ask a space's managing app whether to authorize a user to read or write. Served by the managingApp (not the PDS), called by the authority of a space governed by the managedspace policy. Authenticated with service auth from the authority.

authorized.description: Whether the managing app authorizes the request.

access.description: The kind of access being checked.

clientId.description: The attested client_id, if a client attestation was presented. Omitted for write checks.

user.description: The DID of the requesting user.

main.description: Space policy that defers each user access decision to an external managing app, which the authority asks via checkUserAccess.

managingApp.description: Service identifier of the managing app: a DID with an optional service fragment (e.g. 'did:web:example.com#forum').

publishPolicy.description: Publish the policy to readers as a com.atproto.space.policy record in the authority's repo in the space.

main.description: List the members of a space governed by the memberspace policy, and their read and write access. Must be called on the space authority's PDS. Requires OAuth with a covering read_self grant; a space credential is not sufficient, so members hosted elsewhere cannot enumerate the list. To make the list visible to readers, set the policy's publishMembers.

errors.description: The space is not governed by the memberspace policy.
errors.name: PolicyMismatch

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return.

main.description: An entry in the member list of a space governed by the memberspace policy, published to readers when the policy's publishMembers is set. Keyed by the member's DID. Written by the space authority's PDS to the authority's own repo in the space, and kept in sync with the member list. Only authoritative in the authority's repo.

read.description: Whether the member may read when the policy's publicRead is not set.

write.description: Whether the member's writes are tracked when the policy's publicWrite is not set.

main.description: Space policy that governs access via a member list maintained by the space host, managed with putMember and removeMember.

allowedApps.description: If set, the authority mints a credential only for these apps, evaluated against the attested client_id. When omitted, any app may read the space and no client attestation is required. Does not apply to writes.

publicRead.description: If true, the authority issues a space credential to anyone, with or without a delegation token. Otherwise, only to members whose entry has read set.

publicWrite.description: If true, the authority tracks and forwards notifications for any user's writes. Otherwise, only for members whose entry has write set.

publishMembers.description: Publish the member list to readers as com.atproto.memberspace.member records in the authority's repo in the space.

publishPolicy.description: Publish the policy to readers as a com.atproto.space.policy record in the authority's repo in the space.

main.description: Add a member to the member list of a space governed by the memberspace policy, or replace their read and write access. Requires auth as the space owner.

errors.description: The space is not governed by the memberspace policy.
errors.name: PolicyMismatch

read.description: Whether the member may read when the policy's publicRead is not set.

write.description: Whether the member's writes are tracked when the policy's publicWrite is not set.

main.description: Remove a member from the member list of a space governed by the memberspace policy. Requires auth as the space owner.

errors.description: The space is not governed by the memberspace policy.
errors.name: PolicyMismatch

did.description: The DID of the member to remove.

main.description: Submit a moderation report regarding an atproto account or record. Implemented by moderation services (with PDS proxying), and requires auth.

reason.description: Additional context about the content and violation.

reasonType.description: Indicates the broad category of violation the report is for.

modTool.description: Moderation tool information for tracing the source of the action

meta.description: Additional arbitrary metadata about the source

reasonAppeal.description: Appeal a previously taken moderation action

reasonMisleading.description: Misleading identity, affiliation, or content. Prefer new lexicon definition `tools.ozone.report.defs#reasonMisleadingOther`.

reasonOther.description: Reports not falling under another report category. Prefer new lexicon definition `tools.ozone.report.defs#reasonOther`.

reasonRude.description: Rude, harassing, explicit, or otherwise unwelcoming behavior. Prefer new lexicon definition `tools.ozone.report.defs#reasonHarassmentOther`.

reasonSexual.description: Unwanted or mislabeled sexual content. Prefer new lexicon definition `tools.ozone.report.defs#reasonSexualUnlabeled`.

reasonSpam.description: Spam: frequent unwanted promotion, replies, mentions. Prefer new lexicon definition `tools.ozone.report.defs#reasonMisleadingSpam`.

reasonViolation.description: Direct violation of server rules, laws, terms of service. Prefer new lexicon definition `tools.ozone.report.defs#reasonRuleOther`.

subjectType.description: Tag describing a type of subject that might be reported.

main.description: Space policy for data that only its owner should see, such as bookmarks, mutes, or drafts. Only the space authority's own account is authorized to read, and the authority tracks no other writers. Has no configuration fields.

create.description: Operation which creates a new record.

In the space authority's own repo, the records the host publishes from the space's configuration (com.atproto.space.policy and com.atproto.memberspace.member) are kept, and the digest is that of the records that remain. Succeeds whether or not the repo held any records to delete. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

main.description: Delete a space. Requires auth as the space owner. Deletes the owner's own repo in the space; other members' repos are left in place. Afterwards, reads and writes fail with SpaceNotFound and getSpaceCredential returns SpaceDeleted. Idempotent. Implemented by PDS.

space.description: Reference to the space to delete.

main.description: Download a space's host-side state as a space meta archive, for account migration: a STAR file with the atproto-space-meta profile. The archive's metadata is the space. Its body is the space's policy, then any state the policy keeps (such as a memberspace member list), then the writer set. Served by the space host. Requires OAuth as the space owner with a covering read_self grant.

Get a blob referenced from a record in a permissioned space. Returns the full blob as originally uploaded. Blobs are not uploaded through this namespace: a space record references a blob uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob, so a client writing blob-bearing records into a space needs a blob permission alongside its space permission. Use listBlobs to enumerate a repo's blobs in a space. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services).

cid.description: The CID of the blob to fetch.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo holds the blob.

main.description: Mint a delegation token for a space, proving the requesting app is acting on the user's behalf. Exchanged with the space authority for a space credential. Served by the requesting user's PDS. Requires OAuth auth.

Get the current commit for an account's permissioned repo within a space. Served by a repo host. When called with a space credential, the caller must send an Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header, and the commit's MAC is returned in the Atproto-Space-Mac response header. Throws RepoNotFound when the account holds no repo in the space, including the case of a member that has never written to it. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services).

errors.description: The Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header is missing or malformed, names an unsupported type or version, or carries an invalid key share.
errors.name: BadSpaceMac

repo.description: The DID of the account whose latest commit to retrieve.

main.description: Get a single record from a permissioned space. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). When called with a space credential, the caller must send an Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header, and the record's MAC is returned in the Atproto-Space-Mac response header. Throws RepoNotFound when the account holds no repo in the space; this does not distinguish a member that has never written from a non-member.

errors.description: The Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header is missing or malformed, names an unsupported type or version, or carries an invalid key share.
errors.name: BadSpaceMac

collection.description: The NSID of the record collection.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo to read from.

main.description: Download an account's permissioned repo within a space as a STAR file, for full-state recovery. The archive's metadata is the repo's commit; each key/value pair is a record path ('{collection}/{rkey}') and the record's DRISL encoding, in strict lexicographic order of the path. Blobs are not included and are fetched separately via getBlob. Served by a repo host. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). When called with a space credential, the caller must send an Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header, and the commit's MAC is returned in the Atproto-Space-Mac response header.

errors.description: The Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header is missing or malformed, names an unsupported type or version, or carries an invalid key share.
errors.name: BadSpaceMac

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo to download.

main.description: Describe a space, including the policy that governs it. Served by the space host for every space it hosts, regardless of policy. Requires OAuth as the space owner with a covering read_self grant. A policy may optionally be published in the space, as a com.atproto.space.policy record, so that syncers can view it.

policy.description: The policy governing the space, including its configuration.

main.description: Request a space credential. Called on the space authority. A delegation token is required when the space gates on the user. A client attestation is required when the space gates on app identity. A space that requires neither offers public access. The resulting space credential reads repos across the space.

errors.description: The space does not exist. An authority may also answer this in place of UserNotAuthorized, so that a refusal does not disclose that the space exists to a user who may not read it.
errors.name: SpaceNotFound

errors.description: Refused on the basis of the requesting user.
errors.name: UserNotAuthorized

errors.description: Refused on the basis of the requesting app.
errors.name: AppNotAuthorized

errors.description: Refused without attributing the refusal to the user or the app. Authorities that do not wish to disclose which perimeter failed may return this in place of UserNotAuthorized or AppNotAuthorized.
errors.name: NotAuthorized

clientAttestation.description: Optional client attestation JWT establishing the app's identity. Required only when the space gates on app identity.

credentialKid.description: P-256 did:key to bind the credential to. Each request using the credential is signed by this key.

delegationToken.description: Optional delegation token establishing the user being acted for. Required only when the space gates on the user.

main.description: Import the authenticated account's repo in a space from a STAR file, as served by getRepo, during account migration, replacing whatever this host holds for that repo. The archive's commit names the space and must name the account as its repo. If the account is the space's authority, the space must first be imported with importSpaceMeta. Blobs are not included and are uploaded separately. Requires OAuth with a create grant for every collection in the archive, implemented by PDS.

errors.description: The account is the space's authority, and the space has not been imported.
errors.name: SpaceNotFound

main.description: Import a space from a space meta archive, as served by exportSpaceMeta, during account migration, replacing whatever this host holds for that space. The space must be anchored on the authenticated account's DID. Must come before importing the account's own repo in the space with importRepo. Notification registrations, credential revocations, and deleted space tombstones are not carried over. Requires OAuth with manage=create and manage=update grants for the space, implemented by PDS.

errors.description: The archive's policy, or a value within it, is not one the host implements. A host will not store a policy it cannot enforce.
errors.name: UnsupportedPolicy

main.description: List the CIDs of blobs referenced by an account's records within a permissioned space, optionally since some revision of that repo. Lets a syncer discover which blobs to fetch via getBlob, and lets an account enumerate the blobs it must carry when migrating a permissioned repo. Scoped to one space: blobs behind permissioned records are never enumerated by com.atproto.sync.listBlobs, which is unauthenticated. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services).

repo.description: The DID of the account whose blobs to list.

since.description: Optional revision of the permissioned repo to list blobs since.

main.description: List the records in an account's repo within a permissioned space, optionally filtered by collection. By default each record's value is inlined; set excludeValues for a metadata-only listing (collection, rkey, cid). Used for full-state recovery. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). Throws RepoNotFound when the account holds no repo in the space; this does not distinguish a member that has never written from a non-member.

collection.description: The NSID of the record collection. If omitted, lists records across all collections.

excludeValues.description: If true, omit inlined record values and return only metadata (collection, rkey, cid).

limit.description: The number of records to return.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo to list.

reverse.description: Flag to reverse the order of the returned records.

value.description: The record's value. Inlined by default; omitted when excludeValues is set.

main.description: List the operation log for an account's permissioned repo within a space, returning operations after a given revision. Primary incremental sync mechanism. By default each created or updated operation inlines the record's current value; set excludeValues for metadata-only entries. Note the oplog is a transport optimization with no history guarantee: a host may compact it or drop it, and it does not survive account migration, so omitting `since` returns the retained window rather than the repo's full history. Use getRepo for an initial sync or when a `since` revision is no longer available. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). When called with a space credential, the caller must send an Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header, and a response that includes the commit carries its MAC in the Atproto-Space-Mac response header.

errors.description: The Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header is missing or malformed, names an unsupported type or version, or carries an invalid key share.
errors.name: BadSpaceMac

commit.description: The account's current commit. Included when the response reaches the head of the oplog; omitted on backfill responses.

cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Absent once the response reaches the head of the oplog.
Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Takes precedence over `since` when both are supplied.

excludeValues.description: If true, omit inlined record values and return only operation metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose oplog to retrieve.

since.description: Return operations after this revision. The caller's own sync position; use `cursor` to continue a paginated response.

opEntry.description: A single operation in a permissioned repo's oplog. cid is null for deletes; prev is null for creates. Operations sharing the same rev belong to the same batch. value carries the record's current value for creates and updates, unless excludeValues was set or the value is stale (superseded by a later operation).

value.description: The record's current value, inlined for create and update operations. Omitted when excludeValues is set, for deletes, or when the value has been superseded by a later operation.

main.description: List the known repos that hold data in a space (the writer set), with each repo's current repoRev and commit data. Served by the space host. This is the sync boundary, not an access-control list: it enumerates only writers, never readers. The set is what the authority claims from write notifications and is not itself authoritative; a repo's host is the source of truth.

cursor.description: Pass this cursor on the next request. Omitted when no repos are returned.

repos.description: Returned in ascending spaceRev order. A repo may reappear if updated while paginating.

cursor.description: Return repos updated after this space revision (exclusive). Use a previous response's cursor or a previously processed spaceRev.

limit.description: Maximum number of repos to return.

data.description: The repo's current commit data (sha256 of the LtHash state), as last reported to the authority.

did.description: The DID of a repo that holds data in the space.

repoRev.description: The repo's current revision (TID), as last reported to the authority. May lag the repo host, which is the source of truth.

spaceRev.description: The space revision at which this repo was last updated.

main.description: List the spaces the authenticated user holds a repo in (i.e. spaces the user has written data to) or is the authority of, optionally filtered by type and/or authority DID. Note this is not 'spaces I'm a member of' — a member's PDS only tracks spaces its user has written to. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

did.description: Filter to spaces under this authority DID.

limit.description: The number of spaces to return.

spaceType.description: Filter to spaces of this space type.

main.description: Notify a repo host that the space authority has revoked one or more credentials. Authenticated with service auth from the space authority, addressed to the repo DID.

credentials.description: The jti of the revoked credentials.

main.description: Notify a syncing service that a space was deleted and its copy should be dropped. Sent by the space authority to registered services, retried until delivered or the registration expires. Requires service auth.

Notify that a repo in a space has advanced. Repo hosts reliably deliver their latest state to the space host, which sequences updates and forwards them to registered syncers with reasonable-effort delivery. Authenticated with service auth.

errors.description: The repo revision exceeds the permitted clock skew.
errors.name: FutureRev

data.description: The repo's current commit data (sha256 of the LtHash state) after the write. Lets the space host maintain each repo's commit data for listRepos.

prevSpaceRev.description: The previous space revision. Omitted on the first update in a space. A gap indicates missed notifications; recover using listRepos with cursor.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo advanced.

repoRev.description: The repo revision after the write.

spaceRev.description: The space revision assigned by the space host. Present only on notifications forwarded to syncers.

main.description: The policy governing a space, optionally published in the space so that syncers can view a description of the space's policy. Written to the space authority's own repo in the space, and kept in sync with the policy. Only authoritative in the authority's repo.

policy.description: The current policy governing the space, including its configuration.

main.description: Write a record in a permissioned space, creating or updating it as needed. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

collection.description: The NSID of the record collection.

repo.description: The DID of the repo to write to (the authenticated member).

validate.description: Can be set to 'false' to skip Lexicon schema validation of record data, 'true' to require it, or leave unset to validate only for known Lexicons.

main.description: Register a service to be notified of writes to any repo in a space. Called on the space host. The registering service is named by its service identifier rather than a bare URL, because notifyWrite is delivered with service auth addressed to that identifier; the delivery endpoint is resolved from the service's DID document. Authenticated with a space credential. Re-registering an existing service replaces its registration and extends the expiry.

errors.description: The service identifier could not be resolved to a DID document with a matching service endpoint.
errors.name: ServiceNotResolvable

service.description: Service identifier of the subscriber: a DID with an optional service fragment naming the entry in its DID document to deliver to (e.g. 'did:web:syncer.example.com#atproto_space_syncer'). notifyWrite calls are addressed to this identifier.

expiresAt.description: When the registration expires. May be later than the expiry of the space credential the request was authenticated with; renew before this time to stay subscribed.

main.description: Remove an account from a space's writer set, so that listRepos no longer lists it. The account is tracked again if it later writes while still authorized. Idempotent: succeeds whether or not the account was in the writer set. Requires auth as an account that may manage the space.

did.description: The DID of the writer to remove.

main.description: Withdraw a write-notification registration made through registerNotify. Called on the space host. Idempotent: succeeds whether or not a matching registration existed. Registrations also lapse on their own at the expiry returned by registerNotify, so this is for explicit withdrawal rather than cleanup. Authenticated with a space credential.

service.description: Service identifier of the subscriber to remove, as passed to registerNotify.

main.description: Replace the policy of a space wholesale. A policy with a different $type migrates the space, discarding state held by the previous policy (such as a member list). The authenticated user must be the space owner. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

errors.description: The requested policy is not one the host implements.

policy.description: The policy governing the space, including its configuration. Replaces the current policy.

space.description: Reference to the space to update.

birthDate.description: User-provided birth date. Might be used to build handle suggestions.

email.description: User-provided email. Might be used to build handle suggestions.

handle.description: Tentative handle. Will be checked for availability or used to build handle suggestions.

resultAvailable.description: Indicates the provided handle is available.

resultUnavailable.description: Indicates the provided handle is unavailable and gives suggestions of available handles.

suggestions.description: List of suggested handles based on the provided inputs.

method.description: Method used to build this suggestion. Should be considered opaque to clients. Can be used for metrics.

A declaration of a Germ Network account

continuityProofs.description: Array of opaque values to allow for key rolling

currentKey.description: Opaque value, an ed25519 public key prefixed with a byte enum

keyPackage.description: Opaque value, contains MLS KeyPackage(s), and other signature data, and is signed by the currentKey

messageMe.description: Controls who can message this account

version.description: Semver version number, without pre-release or build information, for the format of opaque content

messageMeUrl.description: A URL to present to an account that does not have its own com.germnetwork.declaration record, must have an empty fragment component, where the app should fill in the fragment component with the DIDs of the two accounts who wish to message each other

showButtonTo.description: The policy of who can message the account, this value is included in the keyPackage, but is duplicated here to allow applications to decide if they should show a 'Message on Germ' button to the viewer.

main.description: A document record representing a published article, blog post, or other content. Documents can belong to a publication or exist independently.

bskyPostRef.description: Strong reference to a Bluesky post. Useful to keep track of comments off-platform.

content.description: Open union used to define the record's content. Each entry must specify a $type and may be extended with other lexicons to support additional content formats.

coverImage.description: Image to used for thumbnail or cover image. Less than 1MB is size.

description.description: A brief description or excerpt from the document.

labels.description: Self-label values for this post. Effectively content warnings.

links.description: Array of values describing relationships between this document and external resources

path.description: Combine with site or publication url to construct a canonical URL to the document. Prepend with a leading slash.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp of the documents publish time.

site.description: Points to a publication record (at://) or a publication url (https://) for loose documents. Avoid trailing slashes.

tags.description: Array of strings used to tag or categorize the document. Avoid prepending tags with hashtags.

textContent.description: Plaintext representation of the documents contents. Should not contain markdown or other formatting.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the documents last edit.

main.description: Record declaring a recommendation of a document.

document.description: AT-URI reference to the document record being recommended (ex: at://did:plc:abc123/site.standard.document/xyz789).

main.description: Record declaring a subscription to a publication.

publication.description: AT-URI reference to the publication record being subscribed to (ex: at://did:plc:abc123/site.standard.publication/xyz789).

main.description: A publication record representing a blog, website, or content platform. Publications serve as containers for documents and define the overall branding and settings.

basicTheme.description: Simplified publication theme for tools and apps to utilize when displaying content.

icon.description: Square image to identify the publication. Should be at least 256x256.

labels.description: Self-label values for this publication. Effectively content warnings.

preferences.description: Object containing platform specific preferences (with a few shared properties).

url.description: Base publication url (ex: https://standard.site). The canonical document URL is formed by combining this value with the document path.

showInDiscover.description: Boolean which decides whether the publication should appear in discovery feeds.

main.description: A simplified theme definition for publications, providing basic color customization for content display across different platforms and applications.

accent.description: Color used for links and button backgrounds.
